snippet.title: Arcade game - Eyes by Rock-ola
snippet.description:
Another one of my favourite arcade maze games is `Eyes`,i just like the idea of shooting what you have to collect but there is something unusual and freaky about the eyes themselves mixed with the random chirpy background sound. A very strange game indeed but I love it.

Playing Tips- 
*After the first screen try not to stay in the same corridor for more than a few seconds and try to twist and turn without back tracking on yourself,like many arcade games this gets difficult very quickly.
*Be Careful when travelling along the sides and top of the screen as this is where the enemy re-spawn.
*Never stop firing as you do not have time to wait and aim just keep firing to maximize hits on items and enemy eyes.

As you can see from the video I did not always follow my own advice and was punished accordingly.

www.jammajup.co.uk
